notes.title: Patchnotes Update 2.4.0c
notes.notes:
Patchnotes Update 2.4.0c


Today, we released version 2.4.0c of Florensia, which addresses some issues and introduces some new quality of life improvements as well as one experimental change that we would like to test together with the community.



Experimental Defence Change
[hr][/hr]
As some of you know, having too much defence in the game results in some cases where players don't get a lot of damage in PvP. We noticed that a lot during the last PvP League, as well as in recent feedback.

We don't want to change how defence works in PvE (so that you guys can continue to tank everything you were already able to tank), but we don't think that the way defence scales for PvP is enjoyable at the moment.

With this patch, we adjusted some things which will result in players' defences being 20% less effective in player vs player combat. Your defences are still 100% effective against monsters.

Internally, we conducted extensive testing and settled on 20% for both physical and magical defence.

As initially stated, this is an experimental change. We will have a feedback thread pinned in Discord. We'd love to hear what you guys think of this change.

 

Changes
[hr][/hr]
Increased movement speed for lootpets (this does not include combat pets).

Adjusted the sea exp death penalty to match the one on land (0.15%). You will only start to lose exp above level 10.

Adjusted Blood Thirst to properly check distance when pulling monsters and players

Lightning Recall is now of type "Physical" instead of "Lightning", which results in the skill now properly using physical hitrate instead of magical.

Added additional client and version checks

 

Fixes
[hr][/hr]
Fixed Vampiric Touch not healing when the skill is used to kill a monster or player.

Fixed HP / MP recovery incorrectly when sitting

Fixed not being able to cast skills / heals when a dead target is selected

Fixed some skills being cancelled if the target died during casting

Fixed Hide (sea skill) still being active when going to land

Fixed an error in the exp calculation that did not properly account for players +-15 level out of range, which should have reduced the amount of exp instead of multiplying it.
In most cases, this should not result in getting less experience if the level of your party was close together.

Fixed various typos in skill descriptions.

Possible fix for a bug on sea that would stop you from steering.

notes.title: Patchnotes Update 2.4.0b
notes.notes:
Patchnotes Update 2.4.0b




Today we released version 2.4.0b of Florensia, which addresses a few remaining issues and introduces some new quality of life.


Changes[hr][/hr]
Adjusted several values for Kommandant Humbert Unruh. We will continue to monitor feedback and adjust values where needed.

Physical defence: [strike]3200[/strike] -> 2500

Magical defence: [strike]3200[/strike] -> 2500

Avoidance rate: [strike]900[/strike] -> 500

All elemental defences: [strike]1100[/strike] -> 600

Added a cooldown of 3 minutes (180 seconds) to the Medicinal herb of Revival.

All combat pets are no longer able to attack other players with skills. Auto-attacks are still possible, which is intended. This change was made to mitigate abuse and avoid several balancing issues caused by pets ignoring the defence. We will keep investigating alternatives, however we believe that this is the correct approach going forward as it creates a more even playing field. 

Changed some defaults for settings:

Shadows: Detailed

BGM sound: Changed from 50% down to 30%

Refuse Party: Now turned off by default

All Tower Party quests can now be handed in to the Roxbury Tower Manager. The quest shells can still be obtained by any Tower Manager on all islands.

Additional enhancements to the multi-client prevention system.

Added thousands separator to several locations where Gelt is displayed, this includes but is not limited to the trading window and inventory.


Fixes[hr][/hr]
Fixed wrong health values for several monsters.

Fixed wrong naming of Woodywoody essences to match the name of the monster: WoodyWoody. Uppercases matter.

Fixed various NPC names.

Fixed various monster names. The names of monsters across all languages have now been standardized to the English naming.

Fixed wrong description of debuff from "\[Elite]Corrupted Maid". The debuff reduces Magic min. and max. attack by 350 and decreases HP and MP by 2000.

Fixed an issue whereby a player would be slowed down, if they were buffed while having Ice Shield active.

Fixed one of the quest markers for "Valuable Medical Stuff" (level 33) being outside the map. 

Fixed in-client "Register" button redirecting to wrong page on the homepage.

Fixed sea ability "Ship Recovery" healing more than mentioned in the description. The values have now been adjusted to match the description.

Fixed partially wrong description for sea ability "Randomly Shooting". All descriptions have been changed to English for the time being with the only exception being German. We will provide updated translations at a later date.

Fixed healed values for several abilities not matching their descriptions. The affected abilities are: Healing Hands, Instant Recovery, Master Recovery and Aurora of Life.

Fixed an issue that allowed for an indefinite amount of teleportations to a players' partner using the marriage system.

Fixed regression in login system that caused password input content to not be detected correctly.

Fixed massive FPS drops in main menu caused by grass & tree nodes not being culled properly.

Fixed a visual glitch causing artifacts in world selection screen.

Fixed a variety of text alignments/visibility issues in UIs, including but not limited to login, character selection, character creation, in-game UI, world map, trade window, and inventory.

Fixed a typo with trade Gelt limit amount in chat.

Fixes various crashes and performance issues

notes.title: Patch Note | Update 2.4
notes.notes:
Welcome to update 2.4.0![hr][/hr]
We're very excited to finally bring update 2.4.0 to you - our very first in-house developed update! Like the takeover for Florensia earlier this year, this marks yet another massive milestone on our journey and we're excited to finally be able to share it with you. 

A lot has been going on in the past few months. We have worked tirelessly to not only understand the code but also to organize everything, clean up a lot of the codebase, create new tools that will aid us in development, create processes for more seamless and faster updates and so much more. There is still a lot of work ahead of us but we hope that you will enjoy this first update as much as we did working on it.

With this patch now going live, we are also opening a feedback / ideas forum in Discord where we are eagerly awaiting your suggestions on how to improve the game. You can find the forum thread here.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25229855/d1797afeb283f3e2226918399c9d21e9552afee5.png"]


Temporary changes[hr][/hr]
As we are currently investigating crashes caused by using the "high" texture quality, we have decided to temporarily disable this option. After installing the game, the "low" quality will be set by default without the option of changing it for the time being. Once the investigation has been completed, we will of course turn the option back on. The "low" option uses the old "high" textures from before the HD textures update.



New[hr][/hr]
Initial implementation of Easy Anti-Cheat. This is a big step towards making the game a safer and more enjoyable environment for everyone. With this addition however, come a few notable changes: 

Virtual machines are no longer supported and the game will close automatically when it is run inside one.

Sandboxie will now cause the game to close immediately.

Easy Anti-Cheat support for Linux has been enabled, making it still playable under Linux environments (not officially supported).

Added an option in settings to enable or disable chat notifications about experience gained by your companion (pet). This setting is turned off by default.

Added travel cards to the 4 major islands (Cardiff Island, Magnel Island, Exeter Island & Chester Island).

Travel cards can be bought from Port NPCs at the 4 aforementioned islands:

Ash (Roxbury, Cardiff Island)

Claudia (Castle Hall, Magnel Island)

Gregory (Glostern, Exeter Island)

Aron (Cherrytown, Chester Island)

Added ???
 Changes[hr][/hr]
New grass textures have been added which replace some old, outdated ones.

Various adjustments to experience distributions while in a party:

The amount of experience gained per player has been significantly increased for all party sizes.

Players who are a member of the party but roughly ~4000 units (≙ 40m) away do not count towards the experience distribution. They will however still add a penalty to the overall gained experience. 

Players who are +/- 15 levels of the slain monster do not add any benefits towards the experience distribution. They will however also still add a penalty to the overall gained experience.  

These changes also fixed an issue whereby a level 1 player would increase the amount of experience gained for other players in the party. 

Added a free skill and status reset when finishing your last class change quest. You don't receive the resets retroactively.

Increased the maximum amount of quests a NPC shows from 10 to 20.

Updated popup window which appears for blocked/banned accounts. The message now shows the up to date support E-Mail address.

Increased character limit for chat messages from 60 to 100.

Increased stack sizes for ammunition of Rifles and Dual Guns from 2000 to 5000.

Moved portal to Realm of Ruins to Weedridge next to the waterfall (D3).

Reduced loss of experience on death from -0.70% to -0.15%. Characters below level 10 will not lose any experience on death.

Reduced overall crafting times for items on all second jobs from 4 seconds to 0.5 seconds.

Renamed the entire Gypsy attire to "Nomad".

Changed cooldowns of the following items:

Phoenix Tail Feathers: 1s -> 10m

Rebirth Egg: 1s -> 10m

HP/MP 100% Potion: 1m -> 5m

HP/MP 75% Potion: 40s -> 5m

HP/MP 50% Potion: 30s -> 3m

HP/MP 25% Potion: 20s -> 1:15m

Special Steampunkt HP/MP Potion: 1:30m -> 5m

Updated splash screen and several loading screens to remove NETTS / AHA logo.

Changed cooldown of "Instant Recovery" from 1.5 seconds to 1 second. The description of this ability always stated that the cooldown is 1 second, the actual cooldown however was 1.5 seconds. We have therefore decided to reduce it to match the description.

Removed "Dock Manager Horns" level 19 add "Black Dragon Worker" and replaced it with 2 level 55 "Black Dragon Fencer".

Changed the Bonus Stats from "Black Blunderbuss of Oblivion" to be different than "Akinas Winchester".

Reduced cooldown of Priest ability "Blessing of the Earth" to 30 seconds to be in line with the other buffs.

Removed "Grade 1 Guild Stone Recipe" from Lake Ghosts, Speculants and Papegaara.

Increased duration of sea buff "Song of War" to 20 minutes on all levels.

Increased duration of sea buff "Song of Union" to 20 minutes on all levels.

Increased duration of sea buff "Order of Speeding" to 20 seconds on all levels.

Removed melee bonuses from the pool of possible Rapier Seals.

"\[T] \[Elite]Lanoir" now also drops "Elite Lanoir Essence" in addition to "Lanoir Essence".

Changed behaviour of Gladiator ability "Lightning Recall" to now hit all monsters in the area of effect independently of each other. Previously, the lightning would "spark over" to other monsters, requiring the very first monster to be hit, or else it would not hit anything. Lightning now also strikes the surroundings of the player.

Buffed Droprate of "Lesser Imp´s Clean Water"

Buffed Droprate of "Elite Supervisor Mole" and "Elite Sound of Deaths´ Keepsales"

Renamed one "Flame Angler" on sea to "Viscious Flame Angler" to better differentiate them for quest purposes
 Fixes[hr][/hr]
Fixed Alchemy tutorial popping up when clicking on a player.

Fixed land tutorial window appearing when reaching level 99.

Fixed missing space in item "BlackShellfish". The item is now correctly named "Black Shellfish". 

Fixed multiple misspelled essence names.

Fixed being unable to respawn in "\[Elite] The 2nd Basement of Avery Big Mansion" after death.

Fixed emojis (yes that's how you spell it) causing a client crash.

Fixed item codes being clicked in chat causing a client crash.

Fixed wrong monsters being named in the quest goal for "Duty of Nobleman". It previously showed "Fungi", when in reality "Weak Fungi" were the target.

Fixed multiple unintentional save zones in Droes Cave of Abyss. These save zones have been removed. The save zone at the portal has been left unchanged. 

Fixed quest "Start of the Adventure (Loading weapons)" for Nobles having cariad and rapier mixed around in the progress tracker. Equipping the Tutorial Cariad and Tutorial Rapier will now correctly finish the respective task.

Fixed several issues causing the "You can't act while moving" message to be spammed in chat. The message can still appear, however it should now only appear when you really can't act while moving. 

Fixed "Trash" (the boss!) dropping "Grim Reaper's Sign" and "Grim Reaper" dropping "Trash's Sign". Both bosses now drop their respective signs. 

Fixed "The 1st Basement of Avery Big Mansion" showing up as question marks in the minimap dropdown when game is set to German.

Fixed "Droes Under Valley" being shown above "Droes Cave of Abyss" in the minimap dropdown.

Moved "Realm of Ruins" to the bottom of the minimap dropdown.

Fixed several NPCs with wrong titles:

Roxbury: [strike]Roxberry Tower Manager[/strike] -> Roxbury Tower Manager

Glostern: HOW Manager - [strike]Glostun Manager[/strike] -> Glostern Manager

Cherrytown: HOW Manager - [strike]Cherry Town Manager[/strike] -> Cherrytown Manager

Cherrytown: [strike]Cherry Town Tower Manager[/strike] -> Cherrytown Tower Manager

Fixed quest "Dark Trade" showing "Male Vampire Noble" as target. It now correctly shows "Female Vampire Noble" as the target.

Fixed "Eyes for Enemy" missing in the set listing of the Realm of Ruins Mercenary set.

Fixed Brid's ability "Curse of Abyss" increasing magic defence. It now correctly reduces the magic defence by 50%.

Fixed multiple incorrect quest location markers.

Fixed "\[Elite]Male Vampire" attracting other enemies in a large radius when attacked. The aggro range was set to 30m instead of the intended 2.3m.

Fixed "Realm of Ruins" map showing wrong player position on the minimap.

Fixed accessory icons being off by 1 pixel.

Fixed "Kommandant Humbert Unruh" and "Tunnelgräber Stein" dropping recipes in quantities more than 1. Due to how recipes are currently implemented, they cannot be stacked.

Fixed being able to teleport monsters and players to the void with Gladiator ability "Blood Thirst" when timing it with teleporting to a city.

Fixed essences getting lost when taking them out of the gear piece using RE100 (or any other variant). There have to be at least 4 available slots in your inventory now, before you can start the process of removing essences.

Fixed some minor spelling mistakes across all languages for log messages in chat when picking up Rifle Shots and Shots. 

Fixed quest items of quest "Last Ingredient" only dropping from "Firefrog", even though the quest says "Lava Firefrogs". The items will now correctly be dropped by "Lava Firefrogs".

Fixed respawn time for some "\[Elite]Guard Boarhead" being 10 minutes instead of 70 seconds. They will now correctly spawn after 70 seconds like all the others.



Known issues[hr][/hr]
We have deployed a tentative fix for the quick slot bars resetting. We are aware that they still occasionally reset but it shouldn't remove all items anymore and it should happen more rarely. We are still working on a fully working solution to prevent this from happening.

Foliage may occasionally pop in delayed and/or show up incorrectly with missing textures. This is currently a high priority target for a fix. As a workaround, switching maps should fix this issue but it can unfortunately appear again after another switch. We recommend to disable it in the settings for the time being.

There is a issue that prevents players from clicking on certain spots in maps, most notable in Droes Cave of Abyss, towards the Golem Boss. We are still investigation this issue.

notes.title: Status Update about first upcoming changes
notes.notes:
Hello,

We have a few things to share today!

First things first: Our new lead developer is going through a lot of different things in regards to the code. While doing so, he is also writing a lot of documentation that is desperately needed. In the meantime, he has also cleaned up a lot of leftovers that are no longer used. 
Right now, the focus is on getting the patching system done and establishing an
automated build & shipping process, so that we can deliver updates faster and more efficiently in the future. 

While we cannot give any timeline at the moment, what we can do is tell you what we have planned for the first patch (so it still can change). But before doing so, please keep in mind that we will start small and work our way up to bigger, more exciting updates.

**Patch verification system:**
This system will verify that the client is on the latest patch. This will allow us to make sure everyone is on the latest version and mitigate potential issues caused by bypassing the launcher. 

**Anti cheat**
While our coder was working on cleaning unused, old code and deleting about a dozen of old and often never used Anti Cheat tools, he started working on the integration of a new anti cheat solution. This has progressed better than we ever anticipated and we are confident that we will be able to deliver this within our first patch. For this, we will be using the well known and well established Easy Anti Cheat solution. 
It goes without saying that this is a huge milestone which will aid us in the fight against bots and cheaters alike. 

With this however, come a few changes.
Namely the fact that Sandboxie will no longer be usable. We are aware of potential negative side effects this may have on some of you, such as no longer being able to trade between two characters on different accounts. We are actively working on finding solutions to this, as well as other quality of life issues. 

This change will also require a fresh installation, for which we will provide an updated installer. We will of course inform you once again when we arrive at this point.

**Quality of life changes:**
- We will fix/remove the "You can't act while moving" spam appearing both on screen and in the chat log.
- Experience points gained by the pet will be toggleable in the settings, so that you can decide whether or not you want to see it. 

On first glance, these changes may not seem like a big step but it is important preparation work that we must take to ensure we can work on a solid foundation. As we are still
getting to understand the code, priorities may change depending on how easy or difficult certain things turn out to be. 

As for what comes after that, we are currently planning a lot of exciting things, many of which we cannot share just yet. But to give you a glimpse, here are some things:

- **HOW:** We are looking into activating HOW on the test server to see whether or not we can fix the known issues and potentially bring this feature back online.
- **ED4:** Most of the concept for this was already done when AHA was still developing Florensia. We even had it on the test server for a short while. Work on this is continuing of course.
- **QoL:** We are also focused on bringing QoL features/changes, such as in-game teleportation cards to other islands, faster crafting times for 2nd jobs, EXP adjustments and more!
- **New textures:** Our in-house artist has started to work on new textures in order to replace some of the more outdated ones currently in the game.
- **Localization updates:** Updates to localization to enhance and fix existing translation. 

The list goes on and on, these are just some of the things we are currently conceptionalizing and working on. We will of course keep you updated on the progress as and when there are news.

Best,

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

As you may know (see previous News) we took over Florensia. We just wanted to give over a small update about the take over process.

In general, we will talk more about upcoming content, etc.  when we are into the code and all tools, but here are some process details:

We got most of the necessary stuff from AHA so far

We have to rebuild several things as they are completely outdated. For example, we need to find a solution to make patches in a way that it can be done on more as on one PC. They use for patches timestamps of a PC. If we start using different PCs (like from different coders), the patching process will fail because of that…

This means we have to rebuild certain tools and processes as we expected.

We need all the crazy old 3ds Max plugins to work, but we will get there.

Our new coder is already investigating the coding side, and we will start with simple things first. He has already found the reason during a first code check why you can not click/walk to certain areas on maps. The reason is that the area was flagged as a Water region.

So, step by step, we will get closer to a workable situation for us.

notes.title: Florensia HD Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Florensians,

We are excited to announce that the long awaited HD patch is finally here!
All textures including monsters, NPCs, players, dresses and much more have been updated with HD textures all across the world of Florensia. 
The new HD textures can easily be activated by going to the game settings and selecting "Hi" under the "Texture Quality" category.
The new low setting will now activate the old high textures. This means that the old low textures have been completely removed. 

With this patch also comes an increase in system requirements, namely the bump in required storage space from around 5GB up to 15GB. The recommended RAM has also been increased to 2GB which, let's be real, shouldn't be an issue at all. 😎

notes.title: Florensia Patchnotes 11.11.2021 - Class Balance Update 4!
notes.notes:
Dear Florensians,

With this patch, we aim yet again to make previously unused skills a viable option to use in the future.
We are also tweaking a lot of the previously changed skills to balance them where needed.

A key aspect of what we are trying to do with this patch is bring more dimensions into the skills.
What we mean by that is that we are trying to make skills useful by adding secondary effects to them, rather than just increasing their main attributes such as damage, duration etc.
Please understand that this is highly experimental and we don't know the outcome of that yet. However, if the tests succeed, expect to see more of those updates in the future.

General changes

 Players now respawn with 50% MP in cities and 20% MP in all other areas (same as HP) as opposed to 100%.

Dear Florensians,

We are happy to announce that the Tower update is now live! This patch brings a complete overhaul to all 100 floors of the tower, with new challenges, updated quests and of course many, many new rewards!

With this update, we aim to make the tower a challenging yet rewarding experience that will require both skill and knowledge of many aspects of Florensia. The combined efforts of a dedicated group that is ready to use everything they have will be the essential key to completing this challenge.

Key changes

 Added many new reward items, including Essences, materials and more!
 All enemies in tower now drop Gelt and Essences. On top of that, boss monsters now have a chance of dropping rare items.
 Bronze, Silver and Gold Military Crosses have been replaced by Platin Military Crosses.
 All existing reward items as well as the new ones that can be exchanged for Military Crosses now only require Platin Military Crosses.


Fixes & changes

 Corrected misspelled title from Roxbury Tower Manager.
 Corrected misspelled title from Glostern Tower Manager.
 Removed non-functional “View ranking” button from all Tower Managers.
 Tower quests can now be obtained and accepted by players with a land level greater than 99.


Important notes

 Tower quests can be obtained on any island at the Tower Master. However, said quests can only be completed at the Castle Hall Tower Manager. This is due to a technical limitation. 


We hope you will enjoy this update as much as we do! As always, if you have any feedback or suggestions, be sure to let us know in our official Discord server!

notes.title: Essence Update - Maintenance
notes.notes:
Dear Florensians,

After more than 2 years of development, we are excited to present you the biggest update Florensia has ever had: The Essence System. Todays 24.06.2020 maintenance will introduce the Essence System to the live servers for everyone to enjoy. 
The servers will be taken offline at 6:00am Central Europe Time (CET). We have no ETA on when the patch will be done but we expect a long maintenance, so please bare with us!

What is the Essence System? The Essence System marks a fundamental change to the equipment system in Florensia. Previously, we had the Fusion System which would allow you to upgrade your gear with bonus stats that would last for 24 hours. While this sounded great in theory, it never worked the way it was intended to and we felt that Florensia was not benefitting from such a system. 
Therefore, we started working on a new concept that would allow the players to customize their playstyle like never before and at the same time provide late game content - which Florensia was lacking.

Now, after more than 2 years of development we are finally ready to release the Essence System and we hope that you are going to love it as much as we do!


What new content does the Essence System provide and how does it work?
Along with the Essence System, there are over 260 new Essence items and 280 recipes for you to craft! 
Each piece of equipment, from your armor to your weapons can now be extended to have up to 4 Item Slots. There are two different types of item slots: Normal slots and Core Slots, latter of which are marked by having a golden border. The only difference between normal slots and the Core Slots are that the Core Slots can hold Purple Essences, which represent the highest tier of Essences as well as some other rare ones that cannot be equipped in normal slots.

To get started with Essences, simply go to any of the lords on the respective islands and click the new "Item Slot" button. In there, you will find everything that you need to extend your gear (create the slots) to unlocking them and even removing Essences from slots, should you wish to do so. 
Once you have the slots unlocked, head over to your skill window, switch to the Action tab and in the category Basic Actions you will find a new action called Essence Management. 
Once clicked, it will open a window in which you can equip your items that have unlocked slots with Essences. 

For more details, visit our YouTube channel, where we have videos that explain the entire Essence System in detail.


Your feedback matters!
We're happy to hear all kinds of feedback you have regarding the new system. To do so, join our Discord Server: discord.gg/giikugames

We thank you all for your patience and wish you fun with the update!

Your Florensia Staff

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/d1797afeb283f3e2226918399c9d21e9552afee5.png

Dear Florensians,

We fixed the following issues in our maintenance today:

- Mounts/riding pets bugfixes
- We have fixed the problem that players could unmount you from your pet, while buffing you. Now you will stay on your mount and get the buffs from other players too!
- We have fixed the problem, that after calling the mount, you could not interact with NPCs or cast skills. Please note, it is not meant to fight on your mount, when you cast a skill or are hit by a monster or player in PvP areas, then your mount will be automatically disabled. So, if somebody attacks you, this system makes a lot of sense, to respond in a fast way to the attacker.

- Combat pet visible bugfix

We have fixed the issue with combat pets, that the correct level and experience were not shown when they were in sealed state after being over level 99. There was no problem with experience or level of the pets, it was only a visible problem inside the mouseover information window. So, the correct levels and exp will be shown in shops again (if somebody wants to sell a combat pet higher than level 99, too).

- Map problem bugfix

We have fixed a bug with the map pulldown-menu. It was possible to click on empty map entries there, showing wrong maps (because these should not appear on these islands). Now there are no empty entries anymore the map pulldown menu is working correctly.

- 2-hands and shield

It was once again possible to exchange items in your inventory to visually wear a 2-hand weapon together with a shield. This was fixed today and we hope that this was the final fix for that kind of issue.

- Sound issues

We are currently working on sound bugfixes, to get a nicer playing experience with Florensia, especially if you’re playing with headphones.

We supplied the first part of the bugfix today and fixed the broken waterfall loop sound, the one which you could hear very loudly on the Rainbow Island, near Rainbow Basin Altar of Memory Safe point. Now there is a really nice environment sound again.

More bugfixes incoming soon! Have fun playing!

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part II
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png

Dear Florensians,

As you know, a wise bard recently uncovered an ancient tale on his journey through Florensia. He spoke of a dark evil, a terrible magic that no one had dared wield until now. If you believe his words, a young magician made a pact with a demon to gain unimaginable power. It is said that his heart is filled with hate and his only goal is to destroy Florensia once and for all. Furthermore, he will not stop until the deed is done. How could Florensia stand against such evil?

After hearing this chilling tale, the adventurers searched for the bard to ask for more information. They were desperate for anything that might help them fight against the magician and his terrible army that they had been told about.

They finally found him in a nearby tavern. The bard listened to their requests and, leaning heavily on his wooden staff, he answered slowly:

"It is said, that for every spell cast nature seeks a balance. To cast a spell so dark and terrible that it could destroy all of Florensia, the magician will have no choice but to create certain anchor points. These will draw the magic focus and connect to cause pure destruction. Everyone who has learned the magical arts knows this. For the release of such a large amount of dark energy, nature will also create light in the darkness, and so bring balance to the world. I cannot tell you for sure what will happen. When it comes to magic, nothing is ever certain. But I am positive the light will give you a way to defeat evil. An adventurer brave enough to stand against such evil will find a way to fight. Of course, he will have to enter the magician's realm and no one knows where that may be...so I cannot deny I am worried. But the only chance we have is you."

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part I
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png

Dear Florensians,

A long-forgotten tale has recently come to light. It was passed down through the generations and told in hushed voices, for fear it could be overheard, since it is a dark and mysterious tale indeed.

Now it came to pass that a wise bard passed through Florensia. He claimed to have extremely important news. One night, many curious adventurer gathered around a bonfire so the bard could tell them of this ancient tale, for he was one of the few who knew about it. He lowered his voice and spoke in a hushed whisper:

"Once there was a dark wizard who was feared everywhere. He was the descendant of an ancient clan that did not want to bow before the laws of Florensia. This brought about a war between the magicians and the humans which resulted in the magicians being wiped out, since they were not powerful enough to face Florensia's army of skilled warriors. Peace returned and everything seemed well.

However, hidden in the shadows, one boy survived, with magical abilities of his own. The rage and grief of losing his family enhanced his powers and he vowed to one day take revenge on the humans who had destroyed his clan. Legend has it that he entered a pact with a demon to gain forbidden black magic. His soul was consumed by the dark force of the demon and fed with anger. The mage resurrected his own hateful army from the bare ground which had remained of his country after the war.

Now he will stop at nothing to destroy Florensia and its inhabitants once and for all."

After the bard had finished his chilling tale, the adventurers looked at each other across the bonfire in sudden fear. Which of them would dare stand against such pure evil?

Your Florensia Team

Sorry for the long delay but it took a lot longer than we thought to update the game so that it works with Steam.

We had the first approval round and have to change some minor things and than we can finally release it. Exact date will follow.

We work on new content as well which got delayed due to the Steam work but we have nice things to come.

See you ingame!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/a6692c9c09113dcd36c898c3b52b79241e863d68.png

*Edit*

Due to a minor issue sadly the approvals failed. We have already solved and re-submitted. So a release should happen soon.
